title: Pay & Benefits: Setting Target’s Team Members Up for Success, at Work and Beyond
summary: Target leads the industry in team member pay and benefits. From financial health to mental wellbeing, time off to reliable scheduling we live our commitment to a 'care, grow and win together' culture.
body_markdown:
## Learning and growth


We are proud to offer a tuition-free education assistance benefit,[Dream to Be](https://corporate.target.com/press/fact-sheet/2025/09/dream-to-be) , giving team members access to undergraduate and associate degrees, certificates and bootcamp programs — both online and in-person — through our partner **Guild** . Available to Target’s U.S. team members on day one, Dream to Be is an industry-leading program that removes barriers to learning, helping team members grow their careers through tuition-free assistance from more than 40 schools and around 250 business-aligned programs with no out-of-pocket costs. Through our investment of over $300 million over four years, more than 10,000 team members have graduated from Dream to Be programs, transforming their lives while driving Target’s growth and innovation.


## What’s next?


Our pay and benefits will continue to evolve to meet our team members where they are, supporting their needs and providing a foundation for a strong future, both in and outside of Target. Learn more about how our benefits are supporting our team, expanding opportunities and building a better, stronger Target.
